briefings.title: Industry Role Shortlist

scope.geography: United States; Cleveland/Ohio prioritized when a sufficiently strong industry match is available
focus: Complex in vitro and preclinical models
R&D scientist, translational biology, and assay development
scope.selection_rule: Include only roles worth serious attention; broaden across adjacent high-fit directions without padding the list with generic biomedical roles.

candidate_profile_snapshot.headline: PhD candidate and predoctoral research fellow integrating experimental biology, computational fluid dynamics, and bioinformatics in human-relevant microphysiological systems.
core_strengths: Stretchable microfluidic gut-on-a-chip and multiplex organ-on-a-chip platforms
Patient-derived intestinal organoids and host-microbiome co-culture
Crohn's disease, inflammation, oxidative stress, radiation injury, fibrosis, and barrier dysfunction models
Single-cell and bulk RNA-seq, 16S analysis, and pathway interpretation
Computational fluid dynamics and transport modeling
Porous PDMS membrane fabrication, photolithography, soft lithography, and additive manufacturing/3D printing
Translational NAMs and human-relevant alternatives to conventional animal testing
Wet-lab assay development, microscopy, barrier/function assays, molecular biology, cell culture, troubleshooting, and experimental design

jobs.title: Research Scientist/Engineer - Tissue Engineering
jobs.company_info: CFD Research is an employee-owned technology company with biomedical and life-science programs spanning human-relevant models, prototype development, and multiphysics simulation.

salary.note: Not disclosed in the posting used for this shortlist.

jobs.job_description: Develop and enhance human microphysiological models using organ-on-chip and organoid platforms for drug screening, countermeasure development, and transport modeling.
key_must_have_requirements: Advanced degree in biology, bioengineering, or a related field
Experience developing human in vitro models
Strong analytical and experimental problem solving
Multidisciplinary communication and teamwork
jobs.why_good_match: This is the strongest direct overlap with the current portfolio: organ-chip development, organoids, CFD, microfabrication, quantitative biology, and human-relevant NAMs all support one coherent scientist-engineer story.
specific_experience_to_highlight: PDMS membrane fabrication and soft lithography
Barrier, imaging, ROS, and molecular readouts
gaps_or_risks: Security-clearance eligibility may be a practical constraint
Formal product-development experience may be lighter than some industry candidates
resume_tailoring: Lead with human microphysiological systems / organ-on-chip scientist-engineer
Put device design, CFD, fabrication, and model validation in the top third
Frame bioinformatics as integrated model characterization
jobs.immediate_action_now: Check clearance eligibility and apply with a one-page project portfolio showing device design, fabrication, biological validation, and quantitative readouts.

jobs.title: Research Scientist - 3D Bioprinting
jobs.company_info: Polbionica is expanding a regenerative-medicine R&D presence at LabCentral and is hiring for hands-on biotechnology and 3D bioprinting research.

salary.note: Range shown in the current listing.

jobs.job_description: Hands-on regenerative-medicine research centered on 3D bioprinting and experimental biotechnology, with an emphasis on developing and learning new fabrication technologies.
key_must_have_requirements: Strong hands-on experimental research capability
Ability to work with emerging biotechnology and fabrication workflows
Comfort operating in a startup-style R&D environment
jobs.why_good_match: This is one of the few current roles where the 3D-printing side of the portfolio becomes a core hiring asset rather than a side skill. It also connects naturally to microfabrication, tissue engineering, organ-chip prototyping, and wet-lab biology.
gaps_or_risks: Direct bioprinting experience may be shallower than general 3D-printing and microfabrication experience
Biomaterials formulation may be more central than in current gut-chip work
resume_tailoring: Lead with fabrication + biological model development
Use the porous membrane paper as proof of hands-on engineering ownership
Show CAD/prototyping and wet-lab skills in the same project bullets
jobs.immediate_action_now: Apply with a fabrication-forward resume and include a compact portfolio panel of printed prototypes, microfluidic devices, and porous-membrane fabrication.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist, Organoid and Tissue Systems
jobs.company_info: Conception is a reproductive-biology biotechnology company developing functional human eggs from induced pluripotent stem cells and building advanced human tissue systems.

salary.note: Range shown in the current listing.

jobs.job_description: Senior-level organoid and tissue-systems role supporting advanced reproductive-biology platform development.
key_must_have_requirements: PhD
Postdoctoral training or equivalent industry experience
Approximately 3+ years post-PhD experience indicated in the listing
Strong organoid/tissue-system expertise
jobs.why_good_match: The scientific content is highly aligned with patient-derived organoids, engineered tissue systems, and model development. The main mismatch is career stage, not subject matter.
gaps_or_risks: The explicit post-PhD experience expectation makes this a genuine stretch
Reproductive biology and iPSC-derived gamete systems are outside the current disease focus
resume_tailoring: Lead with organoid and tissue-system development rather than gut disease
Emphasize transferable model-development principles and reproducibility
Do not hide the seniority gap; signal openness to appropriate leveling
jobs.immediate_action_now: Apply only if the role allows leveling flexibility; otherwise monitor Conception for Scientist-level organoid openings.

jobs.title: Research Scientist - In Vitro Pharmacology
jobs.company_info: BioLegacy Research is a preclinical research organization supporting biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies with in-vitro pharmacology and development studies.

salary.note: Range shown in the current listing.

jobs.job_description: Preclinical in-vitro pharmacology role supporting development of therapeutic programs for biotech and pharmaceutical clients.
key_must_have_requirements: Strong in-vitro experimental skills
Ability to design, execute, and interpret preclinical studies
Reliable assay execution and troubleshooting
jobs.why_good_match: The role uses the wet-lab, model-development, quantitative assay, and troubleshooting parts of the portfolio directly. It is less engineering-heavy than CFD Research but probably easier to translate into mainstream biotech experience.
gaps_or_risks: Direct pharmacology/CRO experience may be limited
The role may value standardized throughput over platform invention
resume_tailoring: Emphasize reproducibility, assay optimization, controls, and decision-quality data
Translate thesis projects into preclinical study language
Keep device fabrication secondary
jobs.immediate_action_now: Prepare a pharmacology-oriented resume version emphasizing assay design, reproducibility, perturbation studies, and quantitative endpoints.

jobs.title: Associate Scientist II, in vitro Preclinical Development
jobs.company_info: AbbVie is a global biopharmaceutical company with large discovery and preclinical-development organizations.

salary.note: Range shown in the current listing.

jobs.job_description: Hands-on in-vitro preclinical-development position supporting experimental evaluation of therapeutic programs.
key_must_have_requirements: Hands-on in-vitro laboratory experience
Experimental design and data interpretation
Ability to execute reproducible preclinical workflows
jobs.why_good_match: This is a cleaner career-stage bridge than AbbVie's expired Complex In Vitro Models Scientist II role. It uses strong wet-lab and human-model experience while providing direct pharma preclinical-development exposure.
specific_experience_to_highlight: Barrier, imaging, ROS, and molecular assays
gaps_or_risks: Associate Scientist II may undershoot PhD-level title expectations depending on AbbVie's leveling
The work may use simpler assays than the current organ-chip platform
resume_tailoring: Lead with preclinical model development and assay rigor
Use organ-chip complexity as evidence of experimental sophistication without implying every project needs a chip
Highlight reproducibility and troubleshooting
jobs.immediate_action_now: Check the education/leveling section before applying; if PhD candidates are eligible, submit because this is a practical route into pharma preclinical R&D.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist, Computational Safety & Exploratory Pharmacology
jobs.company_info: Merck's nonclinical drug-safety organization integrates computational and experimental approaches to evaluate physiological and pharmacological risk during drug development.

salary.note: Range shown in the current listing.

jobs.job_description: Nonclinical drug-safety role seeking a biomedical engineer or integrative systems scientist with signal-processing and/or computational modeling experience using physiological data.
key_must_have_requirements: Biomedical engineering or integrative systems-science background
Computational modeling and/or signal-processing experience
Ability to connect quantitative models to physiological or pharmacological questions
jobs.why_good_match: This is unusually relevant to the engineering side of the portfolio. CFD, transport modeling, quantitative biology, and experimental physiology can be positioned together instead of forcing a choice between computational and wet-lab identity.
specific_experience_to_highlight: Experimental biology used to validate models
gaps_or_risks: Drug-safety pharmacology experience may be limited
Signal processing may be less developed than CFD and bioinformatics
Senior Scientist title may require more direct industry experience
resume_tailoring: Build a computational-biomedical-engineering version of the resume
Put modeling methods and physiological interpretation together
De-emphasize fabrication details unless they support model validation
jobs.immediate_action_now: Read the exact modeling requirements closely; if CFD/physiological modeling qualifies, apply as a differentiated engineering-to-pharma transition.

jobs.title: Toxicology Research Scientist
jobs.company_info: Vertex is a biotechnology company with a Predictive and Investigative Safety Assessment group focused on translational toxicology and drug safety.

salary.note: Range shown in the current listing.

jobs.job_description: Lab-based predictive and investigative toxicology position supporting safety assessment of therapeutic programs.
key_must_have_requirements: Strong experimental biology background
Ability to investigate mechanisms of toxicity
Quantitative data interpretation and experimental design
jobs.why_good_match: Radiation injury, oxidative stress, DNA-damage, barrier failure, rescue experiments, and NAMs give a credible mechanistic-safety narrative. The role also rewards model systems that can explain why injury occurs, not merely report a phenotype.
gaps_or_risks: Formal toxicology training may be limited
Direct regulated safety-assessment experience may be absent
resume_tailoring: Lead with mechanistic injury and safety biology rather than gut-chip fabrication
Frame radiation work as exposure-response and mechanism-of-injury research
Highlight rescue/intervention experiments
jobs.immediate_action_now: Create a toxicology-specific project section centered on radiation injury, oxidative stress, DNA damage, and barrier dysfunction before applying.

jobs.title: Scientist II, Translational Research
jobs.company_info: Tempus is a precision-medicine company combining molecular data, clinical data, and computational platforms to support translational and therapeutic research.

salary.note: Range shown in the current listing.

jobs.job_description: Translational research position within a precision-medicine environment that connects biological questions with molecular and data-rich evidence.
key_must_have_requirements: Strong translational-science foundation
Ability to interpret complex biological datasets
Cross-functional scientific communication
jobs.why_good_match: This role uses the hybrid wet-lab/bioinformatics identity well. Patient-derived models, single-cell and bulk RNA-seq, pathway analysis, and disease-specific phenotyping create a credible translational story.
specific_experience_to_highlight: Linking molecular signatures to barrier/inflammatory phenotypes
gaps_or_risks: Clinical-data experience may be lighter than molecular/experimental experience
The role may be less hands-on engineering than the current portfolio
resume_tailoring: Lead with patient-derived translational models and omics
Describe experiments as phenotype-to-molecular-mechanism studies
Move CFD and fabrication to a secondary technical section
jobs.immediate_action_now: Prepare a translational-biology resume variant showing how patient-derived models and omics jointly answer disease questions.

briefings.overall_takeaway: The broader scan reinforces three credible industry lanes: human-relevant model/platform development, preclinical and mechanistic safety biology, and hybrid translational/computational biology. The strongest differentiator remains the ability to connect engineered models with real biological readouts rather than presenting as a generic biomedical engineer.
